PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Plane Geometry.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plane Geometry.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Plain Scale Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plain Scale Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Plain Scale Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plain Scale Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plain Scale Drawing.

5. When learning Composite Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials.

6. When learning Visual Programming, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming.

7. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

8. When learning Ceramic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceramic Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceramic Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Ceramic Materials.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

10. When learning Fire Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fire Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fire Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fire Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fire Safety.

11. When learning Computer Software, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Software.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Software.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Software.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Software.

12. When learning Dimensioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Dimensioning.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Dimensioning.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Dimensioning.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Dimensioning.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Dimensioning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Plain Scale Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Visual Programming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
